No. 1982/3 – MONDAY,AUGUST, 29, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT
(CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 7

IT is hereby notice that Advance Tracing and date of inquiry 27.10.2015 mentioned in the Part (III) of the Gazette bearing No. 1932/51 dated 16.09.2015 to be amended the Advance Tracing as Preliminary Plan the date of inquiry as 05.09.2016 and the description of the Lots 1 to 6 to be amended as follows.

I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/servitude which are required for a public purpose. Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired:

Six (06) allotments below name land shown in Preliminary Plan No. Ku. 2300 and 27.02.2014, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Kuleepitiya and Minor Division of Udapola Othota East Korale in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Polgahawela, in the District of Kurunegala in North Western Province.
01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: —; Description: Highland; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: -; Extent: 0.0003 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Orange Grove Group; Description: Highland; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: National Water Supply & Drainage Board; Extent: 0.0085 Hectare.

03. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: —; Description: Highland; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: National Water Supply & Drainage Board; Extent: 0.0044 Hectare. 04. Lot No. 4 Name of the Land: Orange Grove Group; Description: Highland; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: National Water Supply & Drainage Board; Extent: 0.0014 Hectare.

05. Lot No. 5 Name of the Land: —; Description: Highland; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: —; Extent: 0.0040 Hectare. 06. Lot No. 6 Name of the Land: Orange Grove Group; Description: Highland; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: J.A. Jayathilaka, Serapiece Garden, Polgahawela; Extent: 0.0179 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorised in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Polgahawela of the 05.10.2016 at 10.00 a.m.
L.H. RAMYASIRI, Divisional Secretary, Polgahawela. Divisional Secretariat, Polgahawela. 24th August 2016. 09-506

THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT
NO. 28 OF 1964 (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: කƍ/අƮ/126/MOD.

I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Amendment Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose. Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired:

Five Allotments of land in total extent of about 1,9499 hectares depicted as Lot No. 01 to 05 in the Preliminary Plan No. 9632 prepared by the Superintendent of Surveys Colombo District Situated in the Village called Thunandahena in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 488/B of Thunandahena in Pallepattuwa Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kaduwela in Colombo District of the Western Province and more fully described as follows.

SCHEDULE 1. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Rathuwilawatta; Description: Home Garden, 09 Permanent Buildings, 03 Temporary Buildings, 02 Water Tanks and 03 Cement Constructed Wells; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: National Institute of Plantation Management, M. D. H. Jayawardhana Mawatha, Athurugiriya; Extent: 1.2380 Hectare. 2. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Rathuwilawatta; Description: Road; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: National Institute of Plantation Management, M. D. H. Jayawardhana Mawatha, Athurugiriya; Extent: 0.2489 Hectare. 3. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: Rathuwilawatta; Description: Home Garden, a Permanent Building Available; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: National Institute of Plantation Management, M. D. H. Jayawardhana Mawatha, Athurugiriya; Extent: 0.1550 Hectare. 4. Lot No. 4 Name of the Land: Rathuwilawatta; Description: Home Garden, 04 Permanent Buildings Available; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: National Institute of Plantation Management, M. D. H. Jayawardhana Mawatha, Athurugiriya; Extent: 0.2639 Hectare. 5. Lot No. 5 Name of the Land: Rathuwilawatta; Description: Home Garden, 02 Permanent Building Available; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: National Institute of Plantation
Management, M. D. H. Jayawardhana Mawatha, Athurugiriya; Extent: 0.0443 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at 10.00 a.m. on the 22nd September, 2016 at the Kaduwela Divisional Secretariat and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 15th September, 2016 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. All deeds and Documents in support of the claims should be produced before me at the inquiry.
W. M. DAYAWATHIE, Divisional Secretary, Kaduwela. Divisional Secretariat, Kaduwela. 09 - 507
